Name: (CR) Kisaa's Twin River Farm
Author: crystalinerose
Description:
[center][size=4]In [b]Twin River, [/b]twin opportunities arise - how well can you cultivate your half of the land with the resources at hand? (Or, just claim them for yourself, if you're not the sharing kind.)[/size][/center]
[center][/center]
[img]http://i.ibb.co.com/tYhckBZ/features.png[/img]

[list]
[*][b]Farm added through AdditionalFarms: [/b]Does NOT replace any Vanilla farms and is selectable from the farm type menu on starting a new save.[/*]
[*][b]Custom starter giftbox items: [/b]Lots of options. Choose before starting a new save.[/*]
[*][b]Custom fish/crab pot catch pool: [/b]Fish for forest and town river fish.[/*]
[*][b]Mini-quarry: [/b]Each half of the farm contains a mini quarry, one for each player (or all for yourself, I won't judge).[/*]
[*][b]Minecart network: [/b]Both halves of the farm are connected by minecarts.[/*]
[*][b]Custom starter farmhouse layout[/b][/*]
[*][b]Supports 2-person multiplayer! [/b](Technically, you can play with more players still, but the farm's design itself is optimized for 2 players only.)[/*]
[/list][size=3]Want to adjust these features to your liking? You can do it all in the mod config! Install [/size][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url][size=3] for easier in-game customization.[/size]

[img]https://i.ibb.co.com/Qfc2pd7/mod-contents.png[/img]

[b][size=3]Gameplay Elements[/size][/b]

[list]
[*]The farm is designed for 2 players, and each half of the map contains an equal amount of resources for each player.[/*]
[*]I recommend playing on this map 'competitively' (i.e. separate funds, building your half of the farm ASAP if that's what you're into), but feel free to play however you want, of course.[/*]
[*]There's not much else to say about this map. It's pretty straightforward. Get to farming![/*]
[/list][i][img]https://i.ibb.co.com/Lx0ybss/config-options.png[/img][/i]

[list]
[*][b]Starter Gift: [/b]Changes stuff you get from the starter gift box. [b][i]Configure before starting the save![/i][/b][/*]
[*][b]Available options:[/b] Farmer (15x Parsnip Seeds), Florist (15x Tulip Seeds, 2x Bee House), Arborist (10x Tree Fertilizer, 2x Mushroom Log), Fisher (10x Bait, 10x Coal, 1x Fish Smoker).[/*]
[/list][img]https://i.ibb.co.com/3NC8PLn/compatibility.png[/img]

[b][u]Compatible[/u] [/b]with expansions like Stardew Valley Expanded, etc.
[b][u]Compatible[/u] [/b]with the following recolor mods: Vibrant Pastoral, Earthy, Starblue.

[u][b]Not Compatible[/b][/u] with outdoor recolor mods aside from the ones mentioned above.

﻿[img]https://i.ibb.co.com/0sYpYjq/installation.png[/img]

[list=1]
[*]Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]﻿, [url=http://https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3231]Farm Type Manager[/url]﻿ and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/28423]Misc Map Actions Properties[/url]﻿ [b](MINIMUM v.1.11.0 REQUIRED)[/b].[/*]
[*]Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/28434]crystalinerose Tilesheets[/url]﻿ [b](MINIMUM v.1.3.1 REQUIRED).[/b][/*]
[*](Optional) Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]﻿.[/*]
[*]Unzip [i]"(CR) Kisaa's Twin River Farm" [/i]archive into your SteamLibrary/common/Stardew Valley/Mods folder.[/*]
[*]﻿Run the game using SMAPI.[/*]
[*]Have fun![/*]
[/list][img]https://i.ibb.co.com/JRHCTRD/bugs-issues.png[/img]

[list]
[*][b]This mod is not made for mobile. Related inquiries will not be responded to and/or deleted.[/b][/*]
[*]Please [b]prioritize reporting any bugs here on Nexus[/b] by following the procedure outlined in the pinned post.[/*]
[/list]
[img]https://i.ibb.co.com/VVn4qL0/credits.png[/img]

[size=3]A HUGE thank you to the amazing chu ([url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/mushymato]mushymato[/url]) for making all the really cool MMAP stuff that makes the special effects within this map possible.[/size]
